notes: §2002:14.8.21.2 SR3: a figurative literal-1/2/4 is one character, national for a national identifier-1 and boolean (ZERO only) for a boolean one. On CD record items the derived lines are AZB, 02, 02, 01 and AB*C, and --std 2002 on the pinned tree matched; g2ins42 (SPACE on a boolean CD item) is refused COBOL1757.
